questions.question: Find the area of a sector of a circle with radius 6 cm if angle of the sector is $60^\circ$.
Find the area of a quadrant of a circle whose circumference is 22 cm.
The length of the minute hand of a clock is 14 cm. Find the area swept by the minute hand in 5 minutes.
answer_steps: In 5 minutes the minute hand turns through $5 \times 6^\circ = 30^\circ$.

questions.question: A chord of a circle of radius 10 cm subtends a right angle at the centre. Find the area of the corresponding: (i) minor segment (ii) major sector. (Use $\pi = 3.14$)
answer_steps: Minor sector $= \dfrac{90}{360} \times 3.14 \times 10 \times 10 = 78.5$ cm², and $\triangle OAB = \dfrac{1}{2} \times 10 \times 10 = 50$ cm².

questions.question: In a circle of radius 21 cm, an arc subtends an angle of $60^\circ$ at the centre. Find: (i) the length of the arc (ii) area of the sector formed by the arc (iii) area of the segment formed by the corresponding chord
answer_steps: (iii) The triangle is equilateral, area $\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{4} \times 21^{2} = \dfrac{441\sqrt{3}}{4}$ cm², so the segment $= \left(231 - \dfrac{441\sqrt{3}}{4}\right)$ cm²

questions.question: A horse is tied to a peg at one corner of a square shaped grass field of side 15 m by means of a 5 m long rope. Find (i) the area of that part of the field in which the horse can graze. (ii) the increase in the grazing area if the rope were 10 m long instead of 5 m. (Use $\pi = 3.14$)
answer_steps: The horse grazes a quadrant (the corner angle is $90^\circ$).
(ii) With 10 m: $\dfrac{1}{4} \times 3.14 \times 10^{2} = 78.5$ m², so the increase $= 78.5 - 19.625 = 58.875$ m²

questions.question: A brooch is made with silver wire in the form of a circle with diameter 35 mm. The wire is also used in making 5 diameters which divide the circle into 10 equal sectors. Find: (i) the total length of the silver wire required. (ii) the area of each sector of the brooch.
An umbrella has 8 ribs which are equally spaced. Assuming umbrella to be a flat circle of radius 45 cm, find the area between the two consecutive ribs of the umbrella.
A car has two wipers which do not overlap. Each wiper has a blade of length 25 cm sweeping through an angle of $115^\circ$. Find the total area cleaned at each sweep of the blades.
answer_steps: Each blade sweeps a sector of radius 25 cm and angle $115^\circ$.

questions.question: To warn ships for underwater rocks, a lighthouse spreads a red coloured light over a sector of angle $80^\circ$ to a distance of 16.5 km. Find the area of the sea over which the ships are warned. (Use $\pi = 3.14$)
A round table cover has six equal designs as shown in the figure. If the radius of the cover is 28 cm, find the cost of making the designs at the rate of ₹ 0.35 per cm². (Use $\sqrt{3} = 1.7$)
answer_steps: The six chords form a regular hexagon, so each chord subtends $60^\circ$ at the centre and each triangle is equilateral.

A round pizza of diameter 28 cm is cut into 8 equal slices.

(i) Find the angle at the centre of each slice. (1)

(iii) Find the length of the curved crust of one slice. OR Find the perimeter of one slice. (2)

A garden sprinkler throws water up to 7 m and turns back and forth through an angle of $120^\circ$.

(i) Find the area of the lawn watered. (1)

(ii) Find the length of the outer edge (arc) of the watered region. (1)

(iii) Find the area between that arc and the straight line joining its ends (use $\sqrt{3} = 1.73$). OR If the angle is reduced to $90^\circ$, how much less area is watered? (2)
answer_steps: (iii) Triangle $= \dfrac{1.73}{4} \times 49 \approx 21.19$ m², so the segment $\approx 51.33 - 21.19 = 30.14$ m². OR $\dfrac{154}{3} - \dfrac{77}{2} = \dfrac{77}{6} \approx 12.83$ m² less.
